title: Bellview Airlines 210
summary: Boeing 737-200 was a 24-year-old aircraft that had logged more than 55,000 flight hours at the time of the crash. While in Accra, the crews had a discussion on the low pressure reading of the brake accumulator system at approximately 650 psi, significantly lower than its normal value of 1000 psi.
